requirements: R1: Read framework.yaml; extract module list and quality_floor config
R2: For each module, resolve path and run quick_validate (8 checks: SKILL_EXISTS, RULES_EXISTS, RULES_PARSE, REQUIRED_FIELDS, AUTHORITY_OWNS, AUTHORITY_READS, RECEIPT_BOOL, ACTIVATORS_VALID)
R3: For each module, run lint_prompts (6 checks: FRONTMATTER, DESCRIPTION_LEN, SECTION_WHAT, SECTION_WHEN, SECTION_OUTPUT, MIN_LENGTH)
R4: Emit adversarial WARNING (not fail) when tags include security/enforcement/receipt/gate and SKILL.md lacks 'adversarial'
R5: Print per-module verdict (PASS/FAIL) with failing check names
R6: Print summary: total modules, passing both gates, failing quick_validate, failing lint_prompts, warnings
R7: --update-yaml mode: print only passing module IDs (for human review)
R8: --write mode: patch framework.yaml quality_floor_passed field for all modules (opt-in)
R9: --module <id> flag: run checks for one module only
R10: --verbose flag: print all check results per module (not just failures)
success_criteria: Script runs on live framework.yaml and reports per-module results without crashing
REQUIRED_FIELDS check correctly fails a module missing 'tier' from skill-rules.json
lint_prompts correctly fails a SKILL.md missing ## When to use
Exit code 0 when all modules pass both gates
failure_modes: Module path in framework.yaml does not exist on disk: reported as FAIL (SKILL_EXISTS=false), not crash
skill-rules.json is invalid JSON: RULES_PARSE=false, remaining checks skipped for that module
